structured.answer: I wouldn't act on it alone; I'd ask my son or the bank first. If I had to choose, the page points to a Psagot securities account with the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" fund (5112628), ending with about 86,045 ₪ after ten years (10,000 at the start plus 500 a month, 70,000 put in), compared with about 81,000–83,000 at the big banks.

stuck.why: The suggested fund shows '−0.04%' with a minus sign; it looked like a loss and scared me
אי.בי.אי. is near the bottom of the account list with a red bar, yet the recommended fund is called אי.בי.אי.; I couldn't work out how both are true
Not sure whether the 7% is a promise or just an example; the 86,045 depends on it
Couldn't tell orange from yellow or what each part of the bar meant

findings.what: Minus signs ('−0.04%', '−1,030 ₪') next to the recommended fund look like losses and frighten me
The fund manager has the same name (אי.בי.אי.) as a low-ranked account with a red bar, which is confusing
The final amount depends on an assumed 7% a year, and it isn't clear that this is only an assumption
Dark background with grey text is hard to read
Orange and yellow in the bars are almost impossible to tell apart
Opens with English index names and the word מדד, which feels like it isn't for me
Terms like נאמן, מחקה and דמי משמרת are not explained
